name: distribution_repair
source_selection: All 1839 frozen corporate actions, independent of holdings, forecasts and returns. Keep every unmatched, multiple, late, malformed or conflicting source case in the review output.

source_verification.manual: Apply only fields explicitly supported by the five existing primary reviews plus the sourced Caitong follow-up. Bind the whole stored action identity and original source hashes. Preserve the Baofeng shareholder-specific entitlement.
source_verification.automated: Require a single issuer-bound implementation filing available under the conservative date convention before the ex-date, exact role-labelled record/ex/payment dates, an explicitly gross amount matching the stored entitlement, and agreement with the already archived structured source. Mere date occurrence, proposals, amendments, multiple provider variants and rounding-compatible differences do not pass.
source_verification.shares: Only an explicitly labelled and independently agreeing share listing date may be supplied. A payment date does not certify share availability or fractional allocation.
source_verification.rounding: Account-level cash truncation may be supplied only by an explicit payment-rounding clause or the existing primary review. Truncation of a per-ten-share distribution rate is not account cash rounding.
source_verification.availability: Use midnight strictly following the catalogue date as a conservative retrospective convention, not a verified publication timestamp. Require it no later than the ex-date opening. Spend cash only at the first observed trading opening strictly after the stated payment date.
source_verification.parser: Read the archived PDF using the pinned optional pypdf dependency; preserve page numbers and source hashes for every extracted field. An unsupported layout stays unresolved.

cash_rounding: Missing field preserves the historical half-up path exactly. FLOOR_TO_CENT uses decimal arithmetic on the entire entitled position before the unchanged tax scenario. Independent reconciliation implements the calculation separately. Continuous base-share gross labels and price indices are not account-cent-rounded.
review_binding: The frozen generated review must bind this protocol hash, the input bundle, every original action identity and the extraction implementation before a snapshot can be built.
snapshot_checks: Rebuild the parent snapshot exactly first. Preserve raw bars, calendar, universe, dated ST metadata, opening statuses and eligibility. Rebuild features, ranks and labels where changed cash affects them; require the non-label prefix before the first changed entitlement to remain exact. Record all action, feature, score and label changes. No source date or field not explicitly verified is filled.
compatibility: On the unchanged old input, reload all 48 models, replay all 1425 accounts and compare all 75 paper accounts. Preserve frozen bytes and old outcomes.
risk: Balanced attack; 8 percent warning; original high-water mark and latched risk; no recovery. No new alpha candidates or relaxed adoption thresholds.
adoption: Retain validated source facts regardless of return direction. Activate a new research snapshot only after source, reconstruction, independent ledgers, model reloads, fixed-forecast comparisons and ST-specific checks pass. Source/engineering validation is not evidence of superiority.
limitations: Historical industry taxonomy/timing and universe selection remain separate unresolved work.
The 111 other quote-gap endpoints and carried-price flags remain unresolved; no synthetic bars or fills.
Retrospective source review does not add a forward observation.
Competition fee and matching details remain unconfirmed.
